symptom: A verified video shown on the legacy Ahuzat Yosef page is absent from the new vacation place page.
expected_behavior: Every supplier-authoritative or separately verified place video is retained in the accepted detail model and appears only on its matching place gallery.
environment: Local cumulative VII release branch release/v909-home-cold-render-20261113 and public pages checked on 2026-11-13.

steps: Open https://www.vii.co.il/ahuzat_yosef and inspect the video section.
Open https://vii.spaplus.co/business?id=vacation-279 and inspect the returned page payload.
Inspect app/data/sergey-place-details.json for vacation-279 and all accepted details.
reproduction.evidence: Legacy HTML contains YouTube embed 7FAVmV3P8oI; public new-page HTML contains no matching video; all 702 accepted static details currently contain zero videos.

observations.observation: The legacy place page owns YouTube video 7FAVmV3P8oI.
The build-time accepted-catalog mapper omitted raw video fields.
observations.evidence: scripts/build-sergey-public-catalog.mjs previously wrote images and gallery groups but never raw.videos or raw.video.

observations.observation: The runtime mapper already accepts safe supplier video fields.
The bounded legacy inventory found verified videos on many accepted businesses, not only Ahuzat Yosef.
observations.evidence: All 702 accepted source pages returned successfully; 156 place identities own 164 exact YouTube IDs in project_knowledge/media/legacy-supplier-video-inventory-20261113.json.

hypotheses.mechanism: Build-time normalization drops supplier video fields, and the verified legacy fallback registry lacks Ahuzat Yosef.
hypotheses.prediction: The accepted static detail inventory has no videos, while the gallery component and runtime mapper can render one when attached.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Count accepted detail videos and inject the exact verified place-bound video through the existing attachment path.
hypotheses.result: All 702 accepted details had zero videos; the exact vacation-279 fallback produces the safe nocookie embed and gallery tests pass.

hypotheses.mechanism: The gallery component cannot render YouTube embeds.
hypotheses.prediction: A verified embed would still produce no iframe after the user activates it.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Execute the actual gallery video-map expression with a verified video and activate its play action.
hypotheses.result: The component creates the expected privacy-enhanced iframe only after activation.

fix.change: Persist safe supplier videos during build-time catalog generation and register the exact verified Ahuzat Yosef legacy video as a place-scoped fallback.
fix.evidence: Focused supplier, gallery and place critical-path tests pass, including vacation-279 and rejection of unsafe embeds.

affected_family: vacation and event build-time detail normalization
business gallery video tab and safe iframe activation

regression_checks.check: Ahuzat Yosef exact identity and video

regression_checks.evidence: Exact hostname, credential, query and ID negative controls passed.

regression_checks.check: Business and event critical page path

regression_checks.evidence: 702 of 702 pages were inspected with zero request failures; 156 place-scoped mappings and 164 videos were generated.

remaining_unknowns: The current authenticated supplier API video count cannot be established from the stale static snapshot alone.
Production remains unchanged until an authorized release and exact public verification.
authorization_boundary: Local diagnosis, code, tests and saved commit only; no production publication or supplier data mutation.
